plan.failurePolicy: Single attempt; preserve technical failures. Keep behavioral failures, invalid outputs and every table. No early stopping, best checkpoint, retries or prompt selection.

inputViews.text: same-schedule replay of public raw tokens, identical across hidden conditions

plan.ordering: Training states and task labels; identical initialization and four fixed epochs per arm; training diagnostics; reserved states; all reserved coding and forecasts; freeze; only then reserved tasks.

primary.discrimination: Within-table AUROC on mixed-outcome tables; any invalid forecast makes that table score zero
primary.interval: two-sided percentile Bonferroni; four loss and two within-table AUROC comparisons
primary.metric: mean squared conditional-code error; invalid native report assigned loss 1

plan.scope: One optimization seed, disjoint assignments of eight fixed keys in one synthetic task. Tests functional prospective prediction from hidden state; no decision utility, subjective-consciousness or architectural-novelty criterion.
